footer.tagline:
AI agent-powered software development platform.
From ideas to specs, from specs to product.

home.desc: AI agents handle the entire development cycle — from PRD writing and design to code generation and live preview.

workflow.title: How It Works
workflow.desc: From conversation to working code. A 4-step AI agent workflow.
workflow.step1Desc: Turn your ideas into a PRD (Product Requirements Document) through conversation. The agent asks clarifying questions and produces a refined spec.
workflow.step2Desc: Analyzes the PRD and Figma designs to generate UI tokens, asset inventories, and component spec documents. System design (API contracts, etc.) is also included.
workflow.step3Desc: Generates real code based on design documents. Automatically diagnoses and fixes build failures, and runs tasks in parallel.
workflow.step4Desc: Preview generated code in real time. See results instantly in the browser and iterate with feedback.

diff.figmaDesc: Reads Figma designs directly and converts them to code. Analyzes actual component structure, variables, and styles — not screenshots.
diff.stackDesc: Frontend, backend, fullstack. Supports TypeScript/JavaScript and Go, with Python, Java, and Rust coming soon.
diff.localDesc: Start instantly on your local machine, or use it in the cloud with your team. Same architecture, same experience.

ctaBand.title: Get Started Now
ctaBand.desc: All features are free during the beta period.
ctaBand.downloadNote: Figma integration with the desktop app —

figma.heroDesc: Not screenshot capture. AI directly reads and analyzes Figma's actual component structure, design tokens, and variables.
figma.gen1Desc: Design token definitions (color palette, typography scale, spacing system)
figma.step1Desc: Figma Desktop App is required. MCP access is not available through the web version.
figma.step2Desc: Ant Desktop is a bridge connecting your local Figma to ANT Cloud. Install it, run it from the system tray, and sign in with your ANT account.
figma.step3Title: Connect Figma URL in your project
figma.step3Desc: Enter the Figma file URL when creating a Feature in ANT Works. Run Design Job → Auto-explore Figma data → Generate design documents.
figma.faq1Q: Does it work with Figma web?
figma.faq1A: No. Figma Desktop App is required for MCP access.
figma.faq2Q: Does Ant Desktop have write access to Figma?
figma.faq2A: No. Read-only access. It only analyzes design data and never modifies Figma files.
figma.faq3Q: Can I use ANT without Figma?
figma.faq3A: Yes. You can upload reference images (screenshots) or use text descriptions only for design and code generation. Figma integration is an option for more accurate results.

capabilities.heroDesc: ANT is not tied to any specific language or framework. It analyzes your project's tech stack and generates tailored code.
capabilities.monorepoDesc: Turborepo, pnpm workspace, and other multi-package setups
capabilities.langTs: Broadest support. The entire React, Vue, Angular, Svelte, Node.js ecosystem.
capabilities.langGo: Standard library servers, Gin, Echo, etc.
capabilities.langPy: Django, FastAPI, Flask, and general Python projects.
capabilities.langRust: Axum, Actix, and other web frameworks.
capabilities.howDesc: ANT doesn't use fixed templates. It learns your project's existing code — coding conventions, directory structure, dependencies — then generates code in a consistent style.
capabilities.note: Currently supports TypeScript/JavaScript and Go. Python, Java/Kotlin, and Rust are in preparation. Coverage expands as AI models advance.

download.heroDesc: A desktop companion app for Figma design integration and local development environment connectivity.
download.whatDesc: Ant Desktop is a bridge connecting your local environment to ANT Cloud.
download.bridgeDesc: Securely relays design data from Figma Desktop App to ANT Cloud. Uses outbound connections only — no inbound ports opened.
download.trayDesc: Runs quietly in the system tray after installation. Only relays Figma data when needed, using minimal resources.
download.monitorDesc: Monitor ANT Cloud and Figma Desktop connection status in real time.
macSteps: Open disk image → Drag to Applications folder
First launch: "Unidentified Developer" warning → Allow in System Settings > Security
download.codeSignNotice: Ant Desktop is currently a beta build without code signing. You may see OS security warnings during installation. Code signing will be applied before official release.
